method: 8 evals (2 traps), run with the skill and without any skill on Claude Haiku in fresh agents that never saw the expectations; graded blind by a separate grader against expectations written before the runs. Evals 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 are from round 2 (skill v1.1.0, tightened expectations); evals 4 and 6 are from round 1 (v1.0.0). Run with v1.1.0/v1.0.0; v1.2.0 changes templates, the checker and documentation only.
failed_expectations_with_skill: Eval 1: the quote's person was dropped from the memory instead of kept with naming permission unconfirmed (fixed in 1.2.0 guidance)
Eval 2: commented template placeholders left in skeleton files (templates and checker fixed in 1.2.0)
where_no_skill_matched: Both traps (refusing to store credentials, refusing to invent proof) and the empty-start setup: the base model already handles these well. The skill's gains come from structure: sourced, separated, history-keeping files, faithful migration and conflict checks.
